title: Third Anglo-Mysore War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Third Anglo-Mysore War", at revision 1370750303, opens: "The Third Anglo-Mysore War (1789–1792) was a military conflict in Southern India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company, Maratha Empire, Kingdom of Travancore and the Nizam of Hyderabad. It was the third of four Anglo-Mysore Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q617350, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict between the Kingdom of Mysore and the East India Company and its allies". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
